title: Player PlayTypes, Tendencies, and Attributes Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: Player 4 PlayTypes are packed as 4 consecutive 4-bit nibbles in [Player + 0x168] bits 0..15, modified by micro-setters 0xf1e370, 0xf1e390, 0xf1e3b0, and 0xf1e3d0.
instructions: 0xf1e370: and dword ptr [rcx+0x168], 0xfffffff0; and edx, 0xf; or dword ptr [rcx+0x168], edx
0xf1e390: and dword ptr [rcx+0x168], 0xffffff0f; and edx, 0xf; shl edx, 4; or dword ptr [rcx+0x168], edx
0xf1e3b0: and dword ptr [rcx+0x168], 0xfffff0ff; and edx, 0xf; shl edx, 8; or dword ptr [rcx+0x168], edx
0xf1e3d0: and dword ptr [rcx+0x168], 0xffff0fff; and edx, 0xf; shl edx, 0xc; or dword ptr [rcx+0x168], edx
claims.falsification_note: Values above 12 (0xc) map to non-standard or unused tactical packages.

claims.statement: Player_SetStatUI (RVA 0x990a10) handles 155 attributes and tendencies via a jump table bounded by cmp ebp, 0x9b.
instructions: 0x990a3d: mov r9d, dword ptr [rcx + rbp*4 + 0x991f08]; jmp r9
claims.falsification_note: Indices above 0x9b trigger immediate branch to return/error.

claims.statement: Player_SetBadge (RVA 0x992d40) accepts badge ID (edx) and level 0..4 (r8b), where 0 removes the badge.
claims.falsification_note: A badge level above 4 is clamped to Hall of Fame.
